title: Why You Need a Day Alone After a Party 🎉
caption:
Amazing night out. So why do you need a whole day alone?

In a 2017 Finnish study, being sociable felt good right away, but about 3 hours later people felt more tired. Reading faces, choosing words, keeping up: it's work, even when it's fun. That's your social battery.

Which level of tired are you on right now? 👇
